Changes: the fork header moved from 00:00:00 to 00:10:00 (a fork is made after the rows it copies; tokscale's test gives both headers the same instant), parentSession paths made relative, TokenTracker's header timestamp fixed at 08:00 (it writes new Date()).
differs: tokscale reconciles a fork's aggregated parent copy against child_usage_attributed rows; we drop the copy by the replay gate (it is older than the fork header − 60 s) and count the original and each child once, which gives the same 150/70. A fork whose header is not later than the copied rows would keep the per-key max (150/70) and count the children again (+50/20); pi-mono writes the fork header at fork time (session-manager.ts:1810-1858).
